</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f883627e-d642-11f1-bf43-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T033022Z-272937822-RC2SDOAFQW00-RTRMADP-3-USA-ELECTION-ALASKA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f883627e-d642-11f1-bf43-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T033022Z-272937822-RC2SDOAFQW00-RTRMADP-3-USA-ELECTION-ALASKA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">dc914a3e-d711-11f1-86cb-bfbbcbd756b8</guid><pubDate>Tue, 03 Nov 2026 05:45:33 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f883627e-d642-11f1-bf43-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T033022Z-272937822-RC2SDOAFQW00-RTRMADP-3-USA-ELECTION-ALASKA.jpg">© Emily Mesner, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>CPJ: 'Attacks on journalists almost always precede attacks on other rights to broader population'</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261103-cpj-attacks-on-journalists-almost-always-precede-attacks-on-other-rights-to-broader-population</link><description>
Annette Young is pleased to welcome Jodie Ginsberg, Chief Executive Officer of the Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ). The killing of journalists is not simply an assault on those who report the news, explains Ginsberg. It is an attack on the public's right to know, on institutional accountability and, ultimately, on the democratic foundations of society. As the global death toll among media workers continues to rise, a deeper crisis is emerging: the normalization of harassment, intimidation and violence against journalists and the persistent failure to hold perpetrators accountable. “If killers of journalists are allowed to literally get away with murder, that creates the conditions in which we see more and more of those attacks,” warns Ginsberg.

Now, publishers Penguin Random House and Ten Speed Press are releasing "Star Trek: The Original Voyages: A Visual History" on Nov. 10, 2026.

This coffee table book promises unprecedented exploration of the pioneering space fantasy television series and enduring pop culture property that bolstered the space race and ignited sci-fi audiences' imaginations by taking us to strange new worlds and civilizations in the final frontier.

It's a striking 416-page hardback written by Kyle Newman and Jeff Bond, documenting all the classic characters and plotlines that are still inspiring artists, filmmakers, authors, and astronauts around the globe six decades later, and we’ve got our hands on a primo copy to show off.

"When the original 'Star Trek' series burst onto the screen in 1966, few could have anticipated the enduring legacy it would create," states the synopsis.

"Although it lasted just three seasons and 79 episodes, 'Star Trek' left an indelible mark on popular culture, and it soon spawned an animated television series, a blockbuster major motion picture franchise, and for its most dedicated fans, a way of life.

"The story of the U.S.S. Enterprise and her crew—James T. Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Leonard McCoy (DeForest Kelley), Montgomery Scott (James Doohan), Nyota Uhura (Nichelle Nichols), Pavel Chekov (Walter Koenig), and Hikaru Sulu (George Takei)—as well as the behind-the-scenes story of its creators, The Great Bird of the Galaxy Gene Roddenberry and his many collaborators, is extraordinary."

Inside this classy collector's edition, which is the first volume of a two-book series gazing back at the complete history of "Star Trek," readers will behold a wealth of archival photos, costumes, storyboards, cast and creators' chats, behind-the-scenes ephemera, props, and filming models.

"Star Trek: The Original Voyages" chronicles not just the iconic TV show but also the short-lived animated series and all six of the big-screen "Star Trek" feature films up to the year 1991.

Above and beyond the dramatic cover emblazoned with reflective lettering, this beefy "Trek" book truly leaps into warp speed, covering all the licensed toys, comic books, convention memorabilia, media parodies, promotional roadshows, trading cards, and vintage magazine covers.

"Star Trek: The Original Voyages: A Visual History" lands on Nov. 10, 2026.

]]> <![CDATA[ Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) lens review — how good is this budget lens for astrophotography? ]]>
Key specs

Type: Full-frame prime lens

Focal length: 35 mm

Maximum aperture: f/1.8

Lens mount: Sony FE & Nikon Z

Weight: 12.52 oz / 355 g

Dimensions: 3.33 x 4.37 in / 69 x 76 mm

Filter thread: 58 mm

Release date: April 2026

Budget primes can be, surprisingly, excellent choices for photographers shooting all subjects. It’s all too easy to get carried away with the best specs, such as a large maximum aperture and impressive optical design often seen in more expensive options. But affordable lenses like the Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II FE (APO) have the potential to impress and delight in equal measure.

The 35mm f/1.8 is a compact and lightweight lens offering a reasonably fast maximum aperture, making it a prime candidate for astrophotography. It’s also the same size and almost the same weight as the Viltrox AF 55mm f/1.8 FE (APO), another lens that could potentially grace your camera bag.

With a highly attractive price tag of just $399 / £385, and mount options for Nikon Z and Sony FE, many astrophotographers will be wondering if this is a lens worth considering. It features 13 elements in 10 groups, as well as featuring an apochromatic (APO) design for reducing chromatic aberration as much as possible. As much as possible is key here because not all lenses are as successful as the manufacturer claims, although that’s not a comment on the 35mm f/1.8. Read on to discover if this could be one of the best lenses for astrophotography.

Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) lens review

Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): Performance

  • Sharp images for the price
  • Sweet spot at f/8-f/11, not ideal for astro
  • Some astigmatism at the edges of the frame

For a budget lens, the 35mm f/1.8 produces great, yet not perfect, image quality. On the plus side, images are nice and sharp, particularly in the centre, even when shooting wide open at f/1.8. At this aperture setting, though, there is some astigmatism at the left edges of the frame. This is where stars appear as crosses. This is a surprise since it’s an APO lens, and, equally surprising, it’s isolated, but it is something you have to consider.

You do have to zoom into the image to see it, so it may not be a dealbreaker. Photos shot at f/1.8 are sharpest in the centre, with some fall-off towards the edges, with the corners exhibiting the least sharpness. There’s also the strongest vignetting at f/1.8. At the time of writing, there’s no Adobe Lightroom lens profile for the lens, but you can manually remove the vignetting and even create a preset of your own.

The vignette disappears as soon as f/4, with a gradual increase in sharpness across the frame between f/2.8 and f/5.6. f/8 and f/11 appear identical in terms of sharpness and occupy the sweet spot, while diffraction is clearly at work when you stop down to f/16. In reality, it’s unlikely you’d shoot beyond f/11 with this lens, even if you were shooting landscapes.

Overall, image quality is impressive despite not being perfect and stopping down to f/2.8 when shooting astro does provide greater clarity across the frame. This is, as you know, at the expense of having to shoot at a slightly higher ISO setting to compensate.

Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): Design

  • Compact and lightweight
  • Manual aperture ring
  • Weather sealed

While f/1.8 lenses may not have the speed and light-gathering capabilities of faster f/1.4 and f/1.2 lenses, they’re considerably smaller and lighter. The lens only has a 58mm filter thread, so if you use any night filters, they will be at the less expensive end of the price scale.

For some photographers, the slight speed reduction of f/1.8 is a worthy compromise, and at 3.33 x 4.37 in / 69 x 76 mm with a weight of 12.52 oz / 355 g, the 35mm f/1.8 is beautifully compact and balances well with camera bodies.

Build quality is excellent, and it’s fair to say the lens belies its budget price tag. The metal build alongside the manual aperture ring gives the 35mm f/1.8 a much more premium look and feel.

The aperture ring can also be set to A for in-body aperture adjustments, as well as offering the ability to switch the aperture click on and off. The latter is most popular with videographers. There’s also a customizable Fn button on the side.

The lens is weather-sealed against light rain and dust, with a rubber gasket on the lens mount. The front element also features a water and smudge-resistant coating, which is certainly useful for outdoor photography. Plus, there’s a minimum focusing distance of just 13.4 in / 34 cm, which is useful for daylight photography but of no consequence for astrophotography.

The 35mm f/1.8 is made up of 13 elements in 10 groups, and as previously mentioned, features an APO design, which is intended to eliminate chromatic aberration in high-contrast scenes.

The elements include two extra-low dispersion (ED), three high refractive index (HR) and one ultra aspherical (UA). The UA lens is claimed to be Viltrox’s LAB Series quality, which matches the Viltrox flagship line-up.

Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): Functionality

  • Smooth manual focus
  • Internal focusing
  • Stepping motor-powered AF

When it comes to features, prime lenses are always pretty basic, with few features to shout about. The 35mm f/1.8 is certainly no exception, but its build quality and overall design hold up alongside its image quality and reasonably fast maximum aperture. It does, however, have a few points worth mentioning.

One feature that many Viltrox lenses have, including the 35mm f/1.8, is a USB-C Port on the lens mount. This allows you to use a smartphone app or a desktop app to quickly and easily update firmware. This is so much easier than having to download a file to your memory card and installing lens updates via the camera, which is how most native lenses have to be updated.

The manual aperture ring features click and clickless operation via a switch on the side, so you can easily see what aperture you’re using at a glance. The focusing ring is smooth and offers comfortable resistance, making manual focus a breeze. It’s also wide enough to rotate using gloves, although, being a compact lens, it’s narrower than what you’d expect on a larger and faster prime lens.

Autofocus (AF) is reasonably fast and silent, being powered by an stepping motor (STM). The AF performance seemed to improve after the firmware update that was installed via the desktop app before testing fully commenced.

This functionality isn’t, of course, relevant to astrophotography, but it’s still a useful point to mention in case you intend to use the lens with autofocus in the day. Focusing is also internal, so the front element doesn’t rotate during focusing like cheap and cheerful kit lenses.

How we tested the Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)

The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) was tested with the Sony A7R V, which offers an unforgivingly high resolution. The lens was tested at night with a focus on astrophotography, and in daylight to assess sharpness, distortion and general functionality for an all-round approach to testing.

Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): User reviews

Online reviews echo one another, praising the AF 35mm f/1.8 for its sharpness and cost. Users appreciate that while it’s certainly not in the league of Sony’s premium G Master lenses, it represents great value for money. Some reviewers mention great build quality and looking good when paired with their Sony camera.

Should you buy the Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO)?

Buy it if

✅ You’re on a tight budget: The price of this lens is extremely attractive given the specs and performance.

✅ You want portability: This is a compact and lightweight lens that's much less bulky than faster primes.

Don't buy it if

❌ You want the best: This is a great little lens in many ways, but its image quality isn't the best that money can buy.

❌ You shoot APS-C: Unless this is what you want, the equivalent focal length on a crop sensor is 52.5mm

Prime lenses can be expensive, especially if you’re looking at those with an f/1.4 or f/1.2 maximum aperture. The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) is a budget option in the Viltrox line-up, but with decent overall performance alongside impressive image quality for the price, this is a great 35mm lens for those on a budget. It’s also compact and lightweight, which could be useful if you often head out shooting with several lenses in your kit bag.

Just going back to image quality, images are sharp, but when shooting astrophotography at f/1.8, there was some astigmatism at the left edges of the frame. This is where stars appear as crosses. You can only really see this when you zoom in to 100%, but it’s worth bearing in mind if you’re looking for the closest to optical perfection you can find.

When a weather-sealed prime lens with a manual aperture ring costs just $399 / £385, you can’t help but take notice. Build quality is excellent and the lens undoubtedly looks and feels like it would be more expensive than it is.

Considering all of this and the image quality, the lens is fairly priced and is still at the release price, so it could become more affordable in the future. Just like other Viltrox lenses, in the box you get the lens, a lens hood, front and rear lens caps and a soft lens case.

If this lens isn't for you

The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.2 LAB FE is part of Viltrox’s flagship lens series and offers a much faster maximum aperture, as the name suggests. It’s also more expensive, larger and heavier.

If you’d like a wider lens, the Sony FE 20mm f/1.8 G is a fantastic option offering exceptional image quality alongside a compact build and light weight. A potential must-have for Sony users.

Researchers know that 3I/ATLAS wasn't born in the solar system, but nobody knows around which star 3I/ATLAS formed. What scientists are more sure of is the fact that this interstellar comet was produced within a planet-forming disk of gas and dust around a young star, possibly as long ago as 10 to 12 billion years. The team's findings were published on Monday (Oct. 26) in The Astrophysical Journal Letters.

This rainbow-hued rocky plain looks like the landscape of an alien world. And, it turns out, it is.

What is it?

In this image, we can see an ancient, rocky hill on Mars. In the Red Planet's Southern Highlands, this alien terrain is chock-full of minerals, which we can see clearly defined in this color-enhanced view of the region.

This image was snapped by the HiRISE camera aboard NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), which has been studying the planet's surface, atmosphere and climate since arriving in Martian orbit in March 2006.

But this isn't exactly what the surface of the planet would look like through our eyes; the image is color-enhanced. Why would scientists take a natural-color image and turn it rainbow? Doing so enhances the slight color differences in these rocks, allowing researchers to pick out the different minerals.

Why is it incredible?

As pointed to above, enhancing colors in scientific images can be an incredibly useful tool for exploration.

For instance, in this image, the blue- and green-toned rocks could be full of minerals like pyroxenes and olivine, according to scientists analyzing the image. And they think that the yellow, orange and red patches may contain minerals formed by past interactions with liquid water.

By exploring the mineral content of rocks like this, researchers can peel back the layers of history within the Martian bedrock. The discovery of certain minerals, for example, can show that water flowed on Mars long ago, pointing to potentially habitable conditions.

So, as we can see, this striking rainbow image isn't just a beautiful landscape; it's also hiding serious clues to Mars' history.

On Nov. 2, 2000, the International Space Station welcomed its first long-term residents: NASA astronaut Bill Shepherd and two Russian cosmonauts, Yuri Gidzenko and Sergei Krikalev. The mission was called Expedition 1.

Before this expedition, NASA had launched five, one-week-long Space Shuttle missions to help build the space station and bring up supplies. But this time, the crew would be staying for four and a half months, and they weren't taking the shuttle. Instead, they took a Russian Soyuz spacecraft, and this was the first Soyuz to ever dock at the space station.

During their stay at the space station, they unpacked supplies and installed new equipment, including the first solar arrays. They left on the space shuttle Discovery, which brought up the Expedition 2 crew that would take their place.

Why it mattered

As of today, there has been a continuous astronaut presence in space aboard the International Space Station for 26 years. For all of these years, not a day has gone by without someone living in space, orbiting our planet from aboard the space station.

While the ISS was not the first space station, it has been the longest-running space statin by far. This first crew were pioneers, showing how humans could actually live and work aboard this station. This exploratory mission proved that the station could successfully support astronaut crews.

Since this mission 26 years ago, there have been literally hundreds of astronauts from around the world who have flown to and lived aboard the ISS. While NASA has stated that the station might be decommissioned in the coming years, these accomplishments will remain forever in spaceflight history.

]]> <![CDATA[ What is Starshield? A look at SpaceX's military satellite network ]]> SpaceX is building and operating two satellite networks at the moment, Starlink and Starshield. What’s the difference between the two, and who uses them?

For more than a week in October 2026, Ukrainian drone operators found their high-speed satellite links shut off. Officials in Kyiv said that terminals for SpaceX’s Starshield network stopped working at speeds of above 160 kilometers per hour (100 miles per hour) from Oct. 14, hampering efforts to conduct defensive operations and intercept Russian drones. Full connectivity was restored on Oct. 24, according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

The arguments over who did what continue, but the affair highlighted how little is publicly understood about Starshield — what it is, how it relates to Starlink, and how it is operated.

What is Starlink?

Starlink is SpaceX’s commercial, mass-market satellite internet service. The company says it now has more than 11,000 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in orbit, operating approximately 342 miles (550 kilometers) above Earth. This follows years of deployment using the company's Falcon 9 rocket..

The network serves consumers, enterprises and government customers across more than 160 countries. It is owned and operated by SpaceX. Anyone from a rural household to an airline can buy a terminal and a service plan.

Governments are also customers, with public agencies using Starlink for a range of purposes including connectivity, disaster response and national security, notably in the case of Ukraine in the wake of the invasion by Russia, which began in February 2022 and is ongoing.

What is Starshield?

Starshield is SpaceX’s network for serving national security customers. The company announced the program in December 2022, stating it would apply Starlink technology and SpaceX's launch capability to government needs, initially in three areas: Earth observation, communications and hosted payloads.

"They are using the same satellite buses," says Bleddyn Bowen, associate professor of astropolitics at Durham University in the U.K. “They look the same, but they have a lot more kit on them that allows them to do more things. They provide similar broadband internet, but with more secure hardware and software and hardened systems.”

The company says it has won multi-billion-dollar, multiyear contracts from the U.S. military in 2026 for Starshield-related services.

Some Starshield satellites may also carry sensors for intelligence and surveillance. But much about Starshield is secretive, with its finances not revealed and launches often classified.

Starshield makeup

Starshield is made up of a range of different assets, including spy satellites, military data satellites, and secure communications for ground users.

The spy satellites are sent into orbit in launches for the U.S. National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), for a "proliferated architecture" of spy satellites, including electro-optical, radar and relay spacecraft. The NRO does not use the Starshield name, but said earlier this year that it had launched more than 200 satellites in recent years, many of which are for its proliferated architecture.

Then there is the Space Data Network Backbone. The U.S. Space Force awarded SpaceX a $2.29 billion fixed-price contract to build the network, previously known as MILNET, using Starshield satellites. It is meant to move data quickly between missile-warning sensors and interceptors as part of the Trump administration's Golden Dome missile defense plan. A prototype is due by the end of 2027. A Space Force official has described MILNET as government-owned and operated by SpaceX as a contractor, under Space Force oversight.

Starshield provides encrypted connectivity for military users through terminals. These can be dedicated Starshield terminals, or Starlink terminals for Starshield services.

Crucially, the networks overlap. "Those Starshield satellites are physically separate from Starlink satellites, but the Starshield satellites can use the Starlink network if they need to," Bowen said. That interoperability is available to U.S. national security users, he added, "but not if you're a commercial user of Starlink."

Use restrictions differ, too. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has said that Starlink's terms of service bar its use for offensive drone strikes, while decisions about Starshield use rest with the U.S. government.

Who controls Starshield is a question that entered the public consciousness in the wake of the Ukraine Starshield speed limit affair. The U.S. government is the customer, and also in some cases the owner, but SpaceX builds the satellites, operates the underlying Starlink network on which some Starshield services run and, in some arrangements, operates the Starshield satellites themselves. How this command is divided between the government and SpaceX is unclear.

Bowen compared it to the U.K.’s Skynet military satellite system, in which contractor Babcock operates the satellites. "The actual button punching is done by the contractors, but the military and government are in the room and are calling the shots,” he said.

That question matters, because it determines whether SpaceX can act on its own or only with government oversight and approval.

What’s next?

Starshield appears set to become more central to U.S. military space. The Space Data Network Backbone prototype is expected next year, while NRO launches will continue, according to contracts. With SpaceX now a public company, quarterly reports could provide more insight into the system. For now, however, much remains classified.

Rocket Lab launched its 99th mission to date today (Nov. 2), sending a private Japanese Earth-observing satellite toward orbit.

An Electron rocket lifted off from Rocket Lab's New Zealand site today at 11:41 a.m. EST (1641 GMT; 5:41 a.m. on Nov. 3 local New Zealand time).

The mission, which Rocket Lab calls "The Sea God Surveys," is carrying an Earth-observing radar satellite to low Earth orbit (LEO) for the Japanese company iQPS. All went according to plan: The spacecraft was deployed at an altitude of 357 miles (575 kilometers), Rocket Lab announced about 56 minutes after launch.

"The Sea God Surveys" was Rocket Lab's 10th launch to date for iQPS, which is assembling a constellation of three dozen synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites in LEO.

SAR satellites offer advantages over those that view our planet in optical wavelengths. They can peer through cloud cover, for example, and study our planet at night as well as during the day.

Today's launch was the 99th overall for Rocket Lab and the 90th for the two-stage, 59-foot-tall (18 meters) Electron, which gives small satellites dedicated rides to space. The workhorse vehicle has now flown 17 times this year.

Rocket Lab's other nine launches to date have been conducted by HASTE, a suborbital version of Electron that allows customers to test their tech in the hypersonic flight environment. HASTE (short for "Hypersonic Accelerator Suborbital Test Electron") debuted in June 2023 and generally flies classified payloads.

Editor's note: This story was updated at 11:55 a.m. ET on Nov. 2 with news of successful launch, then again at 1 p.m. EST with news of successful satellite deployment.

To Prime and Beyond

From 2002’s Resident Evil remake to the more recent successes with Resident Evil 2 & 4, Capcom has managed to recreate the feeling and survival horror tropes of the originals while modernizing the gameplay.

To Prime and Beyond

From 2002’s Resident Evil remake to the more recent successes with Resident Evil 2 & 4, Capcom has managed to recreate the feeling and survival horror tropes of the originals while modernizing the gameplay.

Whether it's the constant tension of being stalked by a Terminator-like Mr. X in 2019’s Resident Evil 2, or the palpable paranoia you feel exploring in Resident Evil 4 — the skin might be new, but the bones are undeniably "Resi."

Prime 4 felt like a game out of time. Sure, it looked the part, but it felt decidedly like a GameCube game. So why not take a leaf out of Capcom's book, apply their "recapturing the vibes" mindset for a Metroid Prime Trilogy Remake, using the Prime 4 engine as its foundation.

2023’s Metroid Prime Remastered showed off the venerable title with better textures and widescreen support, but a remake powered by the fourth game’s engine could showcase the opening and Tallon IV in a whole new light.

Similar to 2002’s Resident Evil Remake with the Spencer Mansion, places would feel familiar but fresh, thanks to updated graphics, better sound, and support for HD Rumble 2 that could help the player become more immersed in the game. And of course, you can change a few things to play off people's expectations.

If Nintendo is feeling brave, the reimagining could even begin at the end of Zero Mission, which is set just before Metroid Prime. Controlling Samus with all her abilities, facing off against Mother Brain in an area not seen in 3D, could be a great introduction to old and new players, as well as giving the opportunity to remake an area from a previous title. Then, players could escape to Samus’ ship, with the ability to pilot it to the Orpheron ship, where Prime begins.

The Return of Metroid Prime Multiplayer

A remake (or remakes) would obviously mean a big step-up in graphics and gameplay across all three games, but it could also herald the long-awaited return of its multiplayer mode from Metroid Prime 2, something that Metroid Prime 4: Beyond bizarrely left out.

Up to four players could take part in one of two modes here - Deathmatch and Bounty Mode, which had players compete against one another by collecting coins to win matches. There were four arenas to choose from, with an additional two to unlock when players got far enough in Prime 2’s single-player mode.

It was a fun time, and its absence in Prime 4: Beyond felt like a big miss, especially with the prospect of playing this mode online with others and using the Switch 2 features like Game Chat.

A remake could fix this injustice, and even expand on the concept by offering new multiplayer modes alongside maps based on locations from across the Prime series. You could even add a co-op mode for the campaign, and a horde mode for co-op fans to enjoy online too.

Sure, she's just had a game, but it's hard not to be nervous after the drought that Metroid players had to suffer in the 2010s.

Capcom was in a similar lull after 2012’s disappointing Resident Evil 6, a bloated and confusing entry that made players fear the end of the series. But the seventh entry, alongside the Resident Evil 2 Remake in 2019, breathed new life into the franchise, which has proved as tough to kill as any of Umbrella's bioweapons.

"That improves post-event situational awareness, helps validate physical models and strengthens our ability to interpret future atmospheric entries, whether they involve natural objects or artificial reentries," Silber concluded.

   <description>Výstražná stávka České televize a Českého rozhlasu 3. listopadu zasáhne zpravodajství, regionální vysílání i digitální platformy. Zaměstnanci protestují proti vládnímu záměru financovat obě média ze státního rozpočtu místo poplatků – změnu schválenou v noci vidí jako hrozbu pro svou nezávislost. K protestu se připojují studenti z DAMU, Univerzity Karlovy i dalších škol, veřejná shromáždění proběhnou ve všech krajských městech symbolicky od 16:36. Deník.cz přináší přehled nejčastejších otázek spojených s protesty. </description>

   <title>Z Jablonecka až do vesmíru. Mezi předměty českého astronauta je i unikátní brož</title>
   <link>https://jablonecky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/broz-kristalove-udoli-astronaut-iss-predmety/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zpravy-region</link>
   <description>Český granát z Turnova, vltavín, broušené sklo i tradiční jablonecká bižuterie. To všechno se vešlo do jediné brože, která by už příští rok mohla zamířit až na oběžnou dráhu Země. Šperk z Křišťálového údolí v Libereckém kraji se dostal mezi předměty předvybrané pro cestu českého astronauta Aleše Svobody na Mezinárodní kosmickou stanici (ISS). Spolu s ním by do vesmíru mohl vyrazit například hokejový puk, ježek v kleci nebo Věstonická venuše. O tom, zda skutečně poletí, ale ještě rozhodnou bezpečnostní a technické kontroly.</description>

<item>
 <title>Politolog Miroslav Mareš: Protesty mladých v Evropě propojují legitimní požadavky s touhou po destrukci</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/politolog-miroslav-mares-protesty-mladych-v-evrope-propojuji-legitimni-pozadavky_2611022359_lhv</link>
 <description>„Protesty nejsou už jenom o těch původních požadavcích. Chopily se toho skupiny, které chtějí destrukci stávající demokratické společnosti založené na tržním hospodářství a okamžitě naplnění nějakých nároků. To vede k tomu, že se část z nich přiklonila k rabování,“ vysvětluje politolog a expert na extremismus z Masarykovy univerzity v Brně Miroslav Mareš v pořadu Jak to vidí.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/navrh_bez_nazvu_3_261102-214048_jkd.png?itok=FuYSBc-f" type="image/png" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Amerika volí do Kongresu. Předběžně hlas odevzdalo rekordních 56 milionů lidí, čeká se 100 milionů voličů</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/amerika-voli-do-kongresu-predbezne-hlas-odevzdalo-rekordnich-56-milionu-lidi_2611022359_jho</link>
 <description>Američané v úterý rozhodují o rozložení sil v Kongresu. Takzvané midterms se v USA tradičně konají v polovině funkčního období prezidenta, a jsou proto považovány za referendum o jeho popularitě. Hlasuje se o novém obsazení Sněmovny reprezentantů a třetiny Senátu, které bude mít zásadní vliv na směřování Spojených států v příštích dvou letech i po konci Trumpova mandátu. Vybírají se ale také guvernéři většiny amerických států.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/navrh_bez_nazvu_7_261102-220943_jho.png?itok=4_AVffCB" type="image/png" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Republikánům hrozí výprask. Trump přitvrdí, ať volby dopadnou jakkoliv, míní amerikanista Beneš</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/republikanum-hrozi-vyprask-trump-pritvrdi-volby-dopadnou-jakkoliv-mini_2611022324_aln</link>
 <description>„Kdyby demokraté získali obě komory, tak Donaldu Trumpovi a jeho federální administrativě na další dva roky poměrně výrazně svážou ruce. Možná kromě zahraniční politiky,“ komentuje ve Dvaceti minutách Radiožurnálu amerikanista z Ostravské univerzity Jan Beneš. Jak brzy budeme znát definitivní výsledky voleb ve Spojených státech? A o které státy svedou demokraté s republikány největší bitvy? </description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/de3ac6cbe10e14cc34d09e3a34a3bdc5.jpg?itok=0iV3Ukm3" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Izraelskou opozici čeká první povolební jednání. Zvažuje spolupráci s arabskými stranami</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/izraelskou-opozici-ceka-prvni-povolebni-jednani-zvazuje-spolupraci-s-arabskymi_2611022231_aln</link>
 <description>Pokud chce izraelská opozice vystřídat dosavadního premiéra Benjamina Netanjahua, musí se smířit s politickou realitou a spolupracovat s arabskými stranami. Prohlásil to v pondělí podle agentury AFP Júsif Džabarín, jeden z předních opozičních představitelů izraelských Arabů. Představitelé hlavního izraelského opozičního bloku se mezitím v úterý sejdou ve snaze sestavit po parlamentních volbách většinu.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-10-27t063618z_4_261027-093844_adn.JPG?itok=VRl7jnk9" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Trumpova vláda žádá soud, aby zabránil Kalifornii ve sčítání hlasů. Tvrdí, že voliči nejsou američtí občané</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/trumpova-vlada-zada-soud-aby-zabranil-kalifornii-ve-scitani-hlasu-tvrdi-ze_2611022049_jho</link>
 <description>Ministerstvo spravedlnosti USA v pondělí požádalo Nejvyšší soud, aby v Kalifornii pozastavil sčítání hlasovacích lístků, které poštou odevzdalo přes 20 000 registrovaných voličů. Resort tvrdí, že pravděpodobně nejsou americkými občany. Žádost federálních úřadů později v pondělí zamítl okresní soud ve Washingtonu. Vláda prezidenta Donalda Trumpa tak eskaluje právní bitvu, která může mít dopad na tisíce voličů do Kongresu, píše agentura Reuters.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/61521f5eaebc4d08447d70262a522399.jpg?itok=caK87jNz" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 20:49:00 +0100</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Ruské pumy zasáhly ukrajinskou obec Komyšuvacha. Zemřelo nejméně 24 lidí, uvedly úřady</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-ruske-pumy-zasahly-ukrajinskou-obec-komysuvacha-zemrelo-nejmene-24-lidi_2611022044_aln</link>
 <description>Ruské letecké pumy v obci Komyšuvacha v Záporožské oblasti zabily v pondělí nejméně 24 lidí a další zranily. Informovaly o tom ukrajinské úřady. Podle prezidenta Volodymyra Zelenského ruská invazní armáda zaútočila na školu používanou k rozdávání humanitární pomoci a na kryt. Šéf oblastní správy Mychajlo Semikin uvedl, že dalších 27 lidí se pohřešuje. Moskva se zatím nevyjádřila.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-11-02t185642z_1_261102-212309_aln.JPG?itok=YE9AVJDK" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Opravit, nebo od něj dát ruce pryč? Němci se neshodnou na budoucnosti Hitlerova Orlího hnízda</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/orli-hnizdo-pozar-hitler-nemecko-budoucnost-oprava-rekonstukce_2611021830_ako</link>
 <description>Německo stojí před netradičním dilematem. Má investovat množství peněz do opravy vyhořelého Orlího hnízda, které je spojené s nacistickým vůdcem Adolfem Hitlerem, nebo dát od obnovy ruce pryč? Experti se neshodnou, důvodem je i opětovný vzestup krajní pravice v Německu.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/1_261102-130322_ako.jpeg?itok=KdABnDsO" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Poláci na Dušičky utrácejí za květiny a svíčky stovky milionů. Škodí ale ‚hřbitovní hyeny‘</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/polaci-na-dusicky-utraceji-za-kvetiny-a-svicky-stovky-milionu-skodi-ale_2611021700_zfr</link>
 <description>Jen za hřbitovní svíčky na dušičkové svátky utrácí Poláci v posledních letech pravidelně více než tři miliardy korun. Za další stovky milionů nakupují květiny. Stále častěji pak také sahají po plastových alternativách. Jsou trvanlivější, ale představují větší zátěž pro životní prostředí i pro správu hřbitovů. Za ekologičtější připomínku v duchu „méně smetí – více paměti“ se přimlouvá stále více úřadů, občanských spolků i samotných farností.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/vic_nez_na_svatek_vs_261101-222625_zfr.jpeg?itok=qFEqQZg4" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Vražda režiséra Pasoliniho se bude znovu vyšetřovat. Podnětem jsou stopy DNA z roku 2010</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/vrazda-rezisera-pasoliniho-se-bude-znovu-vysetrovat-podnetem-jsou-stopy-dna-z_2611021426_adn</link>
 <description>Římská prokuratura zahájila nové vyšetřování vraždy režiséra a spisovatele Piera Paola Pasoliniho, který byl zavražděn v římské čtvrti Ostia v noci z 1. na 2. listopadu 1975. Učinila tak na podnět právníka Stefana Maccioniho, který požádal o znovuotevření případu na základě stop DNA shromážděných v roce 2010. Cílem je znovu prověřit, zda se na zločinu nepodílely další osoby. Informovala o tom v pondělí agentura APA.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/profimedia-104986882_261102-134641_adn.jpg?itok=VNmDowAy" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Až 50 stupňů v lednici. Obchody v Belgii, Lucembursku a Švédsku zasáhl kyberútok, podobný jako ve Francii</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/az-50-stupnu-v-lednici-obchody-v-belgii-lucembursku-a-svedsku-zasahl-kyberutok_2611021309_lhv</link>
 <description>Desítky supermarketů v Belgii a Lucembursku mají kvůli kybernetickému útoku problémy s mrazáky a lednicemi. Napsala to v pondělí agentura Belga, podle níž se to týká řetězců firem Ahold Delhaize, Carrefour či Spar. Také chladící zařízení v některých obchodech ve Švédsku, Irsku a Estonsku zasáhl kybernetický útok, píší server listu Dagens Nyheter a agentura Reuters.</description>

Dostane se brož s vltavínem na palubu ISS?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904740-sperk-z-kristaloveho-udoli-miri-ke-hvezdam-dostane-se-broz-s-vltavinem-na-palubu-iss.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904740-sperk-z-kristaloveho-udoli-miri-ke-hvezdam-dostane-se-broz-s-vltavinem-na-palubu-iss.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Tradiční české sklářství a šperkařství má nakročeno k historickému úspěchu. Odborná komise navrhla unikátní brož z Křišťálového údolí mezi předměty, které by mohl český astronaut Aleš Svoboda již v příštím roce vynést na palubu Mezinárodní kosmické stanice (ISS).</description></item><item><title>V Liberci se dnes znovu lidé sejdou aby podpořili veřejnoprávní média</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904724-v-liberci-se-v-utery-znovu-lide-sejdou-aby-podporili-verejnopravni-media.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904724-v-liberci-se-v-utery-znovu-lide-sejdou-aby-podporili-verejnopravni-media.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 03 Nov 2026 06:30:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>V Liberci se dnes (3. 11.) v 16:36 znovu lidé sejdou, aby podpořili nezávislost veřejnoprávních médií. Demonstraci před libereckou radnicí organizuje tentokrát liberecké studio Českého rozhlasu ve spolupráci se zdejším studiem České televize. Zaměstnanci obou médií vyhlásili na dnešek stávku.</description></item><item><title>Liberecký hejtman Půta je starostou Hrádku nad Nisou, na postu hejtmana skončí</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904723-liberecky-hejtman-puta-je-starostou-hradku-nad-nisou-na-postu-hejtmana.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904723-liberecky-hejtman-puta-je-starostou-hradku-nad-nisou-na-postu-hejtmana.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 20:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Liberecký hejtman a nový senátor Martin Půta ze Starostů pro Liberecký kraj je po 14 letech znovu starostou příhraničního Hrádku nad Nisou na Liberecku. Na postu hejtmana chce do konce letošního roku skončit, odmítl, že by byl "sběratelem funkcí".</description></item><item><title>Na 18 úsecích silnic v Libereckém kraji je ode dneška povinná zimní výbava</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/904706-na-18-usecich-silnic-v-libereckem-kraji-je-ode-dneska-povinna-zimni-vybava.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/904706-na-18-usecich-silnic-v-libereckem-kraji-je-ode-dneska-povinna-zimni-vybava.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 19:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Na 18 úsecích v Libereckém kraji musí mít řidiči ode dneška na autech zimní pneumatiky. Přestože zatím sněžilo jen v nejvyšších částech hor, silničáři aktivovali dopravní značky, které umožňují vjezd pouze se zimní výbavou.</description></item><item><title>Osm z deseti Čechů před Vánoci řeší nečekaný dárek. Co potěší kolegy a vzdálené příbuzné?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903776-osm-z-deseti-cechu-pred-vanoci-resi-necekany-darek-co-potesi-kolegy-a-vzdalene-pribuzne.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903776-osm-z-deseti-cechu-pred-vanoci-resi-necekany-darek-co-potesi-kolegy-a-vzdalene-pribuzne.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 18:10:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Společnost</category><description>Dárek pro kolegu nebo vzdálenou tetu, kterou člověk vidí jednou za rok, se vybírá nejhůř. Většina Čechů před Vánoci alespoň někdy potřebuje nečekaně obdarovat někoho, s kým původně nepočítala. Průzkum ukázal, kolik jsou lidé ochotni za dárek utratit a po čem sáhnou, když dochází čas.</description></item><item><title>Zásah na jezeře Kristýna: Hasiče zalarmovala podezřelá skvrna na hladině</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904704-zasah-na-jezere-kristyna-hasice-zalarmovala-podezrela-skvrna-na-hladine.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904704-zasah-na-jezere-kristyna-hasice-zalarmovala-podezrela-skvrna-na-hladine.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:31:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Pondělní výjezd záchranných složek k jezeru Kristýna v Hrádku nad Nisou k nahlášenému úniku ropného produktu vyvolal obavy z ekologické havárie. Průzkum vodní plochy oblíbeného rekreačního areálu však přinesl překvapivé vysvětlení, které všechny přítomné uklidnilo.</description></item><item><title>Týden bez deště, postupně bude přibývat slunce</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904670-tyden-bez-deste-postupne-bude-pribyvat-slunce.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904670-tyden-bez-deste-postupne-bude-pribyvat-slunce.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:55:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Pětačtyřicátý týden letošního roku nabídne poměrně stálé počasí. Zpočátku bude více oblačnosti, postupně se ale bude stále více prosazovat i slunce. Teploty se budou pohybovat kolem osmi stupňů, rána s jasnou oblohou ale přinesou už i teploty pod bodem mrazu.</description></item><item><title>Muž, který chtěl v České Lípě v sobotu v jedné z ubytoven vraždit, je ve vazbě</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904684-muz-ktery-chtel-v-ceske-lipe-v-sobotu-v-jedne-z-ubytoven-vrazdit-je-ve-vazbe.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904684-muz-ktery-chtel-v-ceske-lipe-v-sobotu-v-jedne-z-ubytoven-vrazdit-je-ve-vazbe.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:55:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Ve vazbě skončil v pondělí muž, který se v sobotu nad ránem pokusil nožem zabít jiného muže. K události došlo v České Lípě v ubytovacím zařízení, podle zjištění Liberecké Drbny v průmyslové zóně v Dubici. Napadený muž je stále v péči lékařů.</description></item><item><title>Zásah v Jablonci kvůli neznámé látce. Hasiči evaukovali desítky lidí</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904676-zasah-v-jablonci-kvuli-nezname-latce-hasici-evaukovali-desitky-lidi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904676-zasah-v-jablonci-kvuli-nezname-latce-hasici-evaukovali-desitky-lidi.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 12:33:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>K zásahu všech složek integrovaného záchranného systému došlo v pondělí dopoledne v Jablonci nad Nisou. Ve skladu Megaknih ve Mšeně byla kolem deváté hodiny nahlášena přítomnost neznámé bílé látky. Hasiči z budovy evakuovali 55 lidí, záchranáři do nemocnic odvezli třináct z nich.</description></item><item><title>Nová vláda pro Liberec. Primátora Hájka doplní osm náměstků</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904664-nova-vlada-pro-liberec-primatora-hajka-doplni-osm-namestku.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904664-nova-vlada-pro-liberec-primatora-hajka-doplni-osm-namestku.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:09:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Starostové pro Liberecký kraj, Lepší Liberec a Piráti s Libercem otevřeným lidem se dohodli na budoucí vládě nad Libercem. Rada města bude mít celkem jedenáct členů - primátorem bude Lukáš Hájek, v radě zasedne osm uvolněných náměstků a dva neuvolnění radní.</description></item></channel></rss>

]]> Mandava Jazz / Mandau Jazz 2026 – Iva Bittová & Duo Jedlinský–Fischer https://www.vybezek.eu/296291-mandava-jazz-mandau-jazz-2026-iva-bittova-duo-jedlinsky-fischer/ Thu, 29 Oct 2026 18:16:24 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296291 Další večer u Kocoura – Mezinárodní hudební festival Mandava Jazz 2026 tentokrát ve středu 28. září 2026, opět ve varnsdorfském pivovaru Kocour, dorazila Iva Bittová a duo Jedlinský & Fischer.

Stejně jako nedávného Dana Bártu i Ivu Bittovou jsme už zažili několikrát (2011 na Vlčí hoře nebo 2017 v divadle). Vždy jako personu velmi osobitou, která si s nástrojem, hlasem a jazykem (nebo spíš jazyky, chvílemi to vypadalo na hudební esperanto-svahilštinu), dělá co chce. A vždy bravurně. Ačkoli ona sama je většinou tahákem na plakátech a v upoutávkách, sama sebe neupřednostňuje a dává spoustu prostoru všem, se kterými v tu kterou chvíli spolupracuje.
